confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are based on aggregated but mixed-year sources (Numbeo, Citycost, WhereAndWhen, LifeIndexed) and a Nairobi comparison, so they are rough. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer anchor, not observed; cocktail is about 2.2x and wine glass about 1.8x the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could confirm (20 March 2026), which is stale relative to the 16 October 2026 generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Price basis is Mombasa-specific where available (Numbeo, Citycost, WhereAndWhen, and a Mombasa comparison tool) and cross-checked against Nairobi restaurant and beer prices. Conversion uses roughly KES 129 per USD, implied by the Citycost sources. Coastal tourist pricing is assumed to sit modestly above Nairobi local-venue prices for mid-range dining.
